claims.claim_text: Anthropic says a new agreement with the General Services Administration gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.
claims.excerpt: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.

claims.claim_text: The discount applies to direct purchases now and to purchases through cloud providers in the coming months, and it extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.
claims.excerpt: including when agencies buy from us directly today and through cloud providers in the coming months. The discount also extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic estimates the discounts will save the government $1 billion.
claims.excerpt: The discounts offered through the agreement are estimated to save the government $1 billion.

claims.claim_text: Under the agreement, agencies are not bound by a minimum spend commitment and pay for the usage they consume.
claims.excerpt: Agencies are not bound by a minimum spend commitment and will be able to pay for the usage they consume.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says about 500 US federal, state, and local government organizations now use Claude.
claims.excerpt: Approximately 500 US federal, state, and local government organizations now use Claude.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February, and federal civilian agency usage has grown about 20-fold in a year.
claims.excerpt: Weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February, and usage across federal civilian agencies has grown about 20-fold in a year.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says that in a four-week Utah pilot giving Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies, 71% reported saving 20 or more hours.
claims.excerpt: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+ hours by the end of the four-week pilot.

claims.claim_text: Claude for Government, at a FedRAMP High authorization level, became generally available on September 30.
claims.excerpt: provides near-feature parity with commercial offerings at a FedRAMP High authorization level, was made generally available on September 30.

claims.claim_text: Claude Enterprise is still in process for FedRAMP Moderate authorization through the FedRAMP 20x program, not yet authorized.
claims.excerpt: Claude Enterprise is in process for FedRAMP Moderate authorization through the FedRAMP 20x program

claims.claim_text: Agencies can buy Claude at the OneGov discount through GSA's Multiple Award Schedule today.
claims.excerpt: Government agencies can buy Claude at the OneGov discount through GSA's Multiple Award Schedule today.
